about: knowledge/recipes/swot-gauge-confrontation.md (signed): the distance between reach and gauge
text: The signed recipe says the reach and the gauge are 0.44 km apart and does not say what the distance is measured to (the reach centre along the river, or the nearest point of the centreline) nor on which side. It matters: the product's reach slope rises by 3.179 ppm per metre of stage on the screened pairs, so each kilometre between the gauge and the point the reach height refers to adds 0.0032 to the gain. At 0.44 km geometry gives 0.0014 of the 0.0140 seen; 4.39 km would give all of it (LOOK-015). Wanted: the along-river distance and direction from the gauge to the reach centre, from SWORD and the site file, so that the gain expected from geometry is a number before any test.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
